implementation_notes: Domain class and method names carry the vocabulary; dataclasses named after the concept, and methods named after the domain verb (`approve`, `settle`, `cancel`). Keep Pydantic request/response models in an api module with a distinct vocabulary.
idiom_name: domain-named dataclasses + domain-verb methods; transport models in their own module
pitfalls: `schemas.py` with every concept flattened to a generic model
